comment: Photos spec PH-01 parity vectors: desktop tools/checks/photos-check.mjs, Android core PhotoFixturesTest. Numbers in rows are rounded to 6 decimals; compare within 1e-6.

takenAt.name: premiere with an offset keeps its fields
no premiere: DateCreated in local time (UTC+2)
no premiere: DateCreated west of UTC
midnight: premiere stays on Dec 31 whatever the zone
midnight: DateCreated crosses into the new year

toAsset.name: jellyfin photo with blurhash and location
video clip, no size: server aspect

orientation.name: quarter turn, pixels as stored: the client turns them
quarter turn, pixels already turned: nothing to do
other quarter turn, pixels as stored
decoded shape far from the prediction: re-layout

sort.name: a DateCreated page re-sorted by takenAt

memories.name: Feb 28 in a common year shows Feb 29 too
Mar 1 in a common year: Mar 1 only
Feb 28 in a leap year: Feb 28 only

long exposure, west and south (en, aperture fnumber)
half a second and a third (fr, aperture hidden)
half a second and a third (en, aperture hidden)
